name: painted-place
description: Build a place in Blender for the series' painted look the way the owner approved: one fresh builder gets the brief kit (the look page and reference pictures, traps, a measure tool, boards of real photographs per kind of place, a shelf of photographed surfaces) and a store of ready parts, tools and materials to pick from (a duckboard walkway on a line, setts, lapped boards with eaves, stonework, puddles, tents, a field gun, huts, lamps, carts, the street's materials, and ground tools for wet ground, ruts of carts and motors, potholes, stones, grass, leaves and twigs), decides everything about the place itself, and the owner judges the picture.
